frozen_requirements.success: Autonomous stop at the correctly bound requested semantic target, full quaternion error <=0.16 rad, no previous drop. Reaching alone is not completion. No extra hold requirement.
frozen_requirements.service_exclusions: Identical matched-triplet exclusion for a service error or measured model request latency >120 seconds in any arm. Always report all 40 raw trials alongside eligible results. No performance-based exclusion or replacement trials.

training.interface_stage: Train goal projection and new latent input columns only. Freeze inherited weights and normalizers. Adam with zero weight decay.
training.pose_noise_stage: Use released simulated perception noise for initial distillation. This is not evidence for RGB pose-estimator performance.
training.teacher_only_information: Goal quaternion and privileged simulation state may label training data but are excluded from deployment student inputs.

formal_conditions.low_level_metric_scope: Physical reach/drop/pose diagnostics, reported separately from autonomous semantic success. A low-level controller does not supply an agent stop decision.
formal_conditions.component_design: 2x2 learned waiting x learned execution recovery. Same final measured-pose stopping path, student, perception, image inputs, prompts, horizon and call budget in all Astra arms. Upper-provider comparisons share the selected full downstream stack.
formal_conditions.checkpoint_selection_status: Pending full common-stack development and fixed-public-plan comparisons. No formal seed data may select checkpoints.
